description: Pulse: "what has changed for the mods I run?" Reads the switched-on mods in an r2modman profile and checks each one against Thunderstore: which have updates, which their authors have deprecated, and which Thunderstore no longer has. Thunderstore games only for now (Lethal Company, Valheim); Nexus and mod.io mods aren't checked yet. Behave like this: call it once WITHOUT confirm. That sends nothing and answers with how many requests a check would make and to which host. Show that to the user, and call again with confirm=true only after they say yes. Never pass confirm=true on the first call. Read-only: it never downloads, installs or changes anything. Use when the user says "are my mods up to date", "what's changed for my mods" or "any updates for my modpack".

confirm.description: true sends the requests. Leave it out on the first call, which only says what would be sent; pass true only after the user has said yes to that.

gameId.description: Canonical game ID of a Thunderstore game, e.g. 'lethalcompany' or 'valheim'. mw_detect_environment lists the games on this computer.

profileName.description: r2modman profile name. Defaults to the first profile alphabetically (typically 'Default').

name: mw_pulse
title: What's changed for my mods
